What is Claude?

Conversational assistant from Anthropic focused on long-context reasoning, careful writing, document analysis and agentic coding. Strong on following detailed instructions and handling very large inputs.

Best for

Long-document analysis, careful professional writing, and agentic coding across a whole codebase.

Main features

  • Very long context windows (200K up to 1M tokens)
  • Artifacts (live documents, code and apps in-chat)
  • Projects with shared knowledge
  • Research mode
  • Claude Code CLI and IDE agent
  • Cowork agentic desktop app
  • memory
  • connectors and MCP
  • file creation (xlsx/docx/pptx/pdf).

Practical use cases

  • Analysing long contracts, RFPs and technical specs
  • drafting and refining professional writing
  • multi-file code refactoring
  • building internal tools via Artifacts
  • structured data extraction from documents.

Who is it for?

  • Writers, analysts, researchers, lawyers, developers and enterprise teams handling long or sensitive documents.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium subscription; per-seat Team/Enterprise; separate token-metered API

Plans described in the source

Free $0. Pro $20/mo or $200/yr (~$17/mo effective). Max in two tiers: $100/mo (5x Pro) and $200/mo (20x Pro). Team from $25/seat/mo (about $20/seat annual) for standard seats, with a higher premium seat tier. Enterprise custom. Education plans for institutions. API separate: Fable 5.1 $10/$50 per 1M in/out tokens, Opus 5 $5/$25, Sonnet 5 $2/$10, Haiku 4.5 $1/$5.

Free plan

Yes - free tier includes Sonnet access, web search, memory, Artifacts, file creation, code execution and connectors. Claude Code, Opus, Fable and Research mode need a paid tier.

Free trial

No separate trial; the free tier is the trial. Enterprise trials through sales.

Usage limits to consider

Every subscription meters usage against a rolling 5-hour session window plus a weekly ceiling, shared across chat and Claude Code. Free defaults to Sonnet with a rolling budget rather than a message count. Max raises capacity but is not unlimited.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Best-in-class long context
  • very strong instruction following and writing quality
  • Artifacts and file creation produce usable deliverables, not just text
  • Team/Enterprise exclude training at contract level
  • MCP gives a clean integration story.

Limitations to consider

  • Session and weekly caps can bite hard during agentic coding
  • image generation is not native
  • smaller plugin ecosystem than ChatGPT
  • Anthropic's own pages have at times been inconsistent about annual Max pricing.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android
  • Claude Code (terminal, VS Code, JetBrains)
  • Chrome extension
  • Excel/PowerPoint add-ins
  • Slack

Languages

  • Strong multilingual coverage incl. Arabic, French, English; UI in several languages

API access

Yes - Claude Platform / Anthropic API, plus availability on AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry

Integrations and exports

  • Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, Slack, Jira, Confluence, Asana, Notion, Canva, Figma, Stripe
  • MCP servers
  • Zapier

Evaluation notes

Max is a capacity tier, not a feature tier - it unlocks no models Pro lacks. Claude Code consumes the same pool as chat, so heavy terminal use exhausts a Pro plan quickly.
